title: Norm-Complete Visual Eurocode Plugins
description: The current eurocode plugins are extremly adhoc. Make sure they are completly norm complete, absolutely visual (3d whenever possible) with rich, immediate, realime editors, etc. Coordinate a fleet of parallel agents (Sonnet for execution, Haiku for exploration/audits).
